title: Standardizing open science: Passion meets practice
content:
Meet our new Ambassador, Chiara Marmo: tech isn't the silver bullet. Maintainable research software requires consistent guidance and institutional support to foster professional coding habits.

The post Standardizing open science: Passion meets practice  appeared first on Software Heritage.
